name: 'ROAD RAGE'  by Paul Ellison
author: therealmacready
description:
Thought I'd build up a mock city and see what happens when you allow a bunch of cars to go crazy. I found it fun.
[!] Remember to also check out the right camera window to see all the awesome destruction [!]
-----------------------------------------
Controls:

Forward = 'W'
Backward = 'S'
Left = 'A'
Right = 'D'

Toggle 1st-Person/3rd-Person = 'LeftALT'
Restart Game = 'LeftSHIFT'
